program_name: Post Basic Diploma Emergency and Disaster Nursing
eligibility_criteria: 1. Candidates must have completed B.Sc. Nursing (Regular) Degree, Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing (Regular) Degree, or General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) course with a minimum of 50% marks, recognized by the Indian Nursing Council, and registered with the State Nursing Council. 2. Minimum one year of work experience after B.Sc Nursing as a staff nurse preferably in the Emergency Department .
